protocol.primary_budget: strict-disjoint candidate count K with 512 nodes per candidate; unique region node budget is exactly K*512
protocol.secondary_budget: shortcut count, boundary/internal counts, compressed graph size, and preprocessing time are reported rather than assumed equal
protocol.paired_timing: baseline and indexed query run consecutively per OD; execution order alternates by query-id parity
protocol.distance_policy: every indexed distance must equal original-graph distance
